_comment: Semantic token → palette step map for LIGHT mode. Values are palette-step keys; the generator wraps each as var(--c-<step>). Chromatic ramps are anchored at step 500 (the brand/default). FILL roles sit one label below their pre-500 positions (the ramp shifted); `on-*` TEXT roles keep their darker label for legibility (chosen for contrast, not re-anchored). Neutral roles (tertiary-*) keep their labels (those ramps were not re-anchored). Finalised against WCAG AA in the contrast pass. Keep keys in sync with dark.json. Mode-invariant roles (inverse-*) live in invariant.json.
_comment-disabled: on-surface-disabled inks disabled text (options, days, buttons) a clear step below on-surface-faint (placeholders, hints), which equals on-surface-muted in light mode. Disabled text is exempt from WCAG AA contrast, so the audit does not check it.
_comment-inverted: Inverted-surface tier (ADR-0032): the contrast-flipping top rung of the surface ladder (near-black in light mode, white in dark mode) for maximum-emphasis transient layers (toasts). Each status *-inverted role is the single ACCENT INK for that family on the flipped ground — the coloured status icon, with its halo painted as an alpha wash of the same role — vivid pre-anchor steps on the light mode's near-black, deeper post-anchor steps on the dark mode's white. Mode-AWARE — distinct from the mode-invariant inverse-* family in invariant.json.
_comment-hover: A filled role's hover moves away from its label (ADR-0081): white-label roles darken to step 600, where step 300 read 2.5–3.8:1 under white; dark-label roles (success, info, warning, accent) keep lightening to 300.
_comment-status-on: The success, info and warning fills are too light for a white label (3.0, 4.3 and 1.6:1, under 2.3:1 on their hover fills), so text on them is dark: the family's 950 step, or black for info, where info-950 reads 4.2:1 (ADR-0079). Warning is yellow (ADR-0080), so its tint ink drops to warning-800: warning-700 reads 3.7:1 on its tint and 4.2:1 on white.
_comment-on-surface-error: Error text on a surface (ADR-0080). In light mode it is the error fill itself, 5.1:1 on white; dark mode splits the two.
_comment-chart: Chart tokens (ADR-0030, amended 2026-09-03): the 12 categorical series slots are frozen viz-owned literals — validated as a set with the dataviz validator (adjacent-pair CVD ΔE ≥ 8 under protan/deutan, normal-vision floor ≥ 15, OKLCH lightness band and chroma floor, ≥ 3:1 on chart-surface) so consumer re-seeding cannot silently void the guarantee. Twelve single hues, no light/dark shade pairs: every slot sits at OKLCH L 0.55–0.67 so none reads as a shade of another, and chroma is pushed to the sRGB gamut under per-hue ceilings. Slots 1–7 keep the original hue identities (blue, magenta, gold, purple, teal, rose, cyan — 1/2/5 on the info/secondary/accent hues, no longer equal to ramp steps); 8–12 are new viz-only hues (indigo, orchid, olive, violet, aqua). Status hue bands (reds, oranges, greens) are excluded. Slot order is part of the contract: assign in sequence, never cycle, never skip. All-pairs (scatter/map) safe prefix stays slots 1–3. Anatomy roles (chart-surface/grid/axis) alias the non-overridable neutral steps behind surface-raised/border/on-surface-muted.
_comment-logo: The CSC logo is a fixed brand mark: literal hex (not palette-step keys) so consumer re-seeding of primary/secondary via applyTheme cannot recolor it. Values equal the default primary-500/secondary-500.
